verified: According to TechCrunch, Zoox robotaxis are now bookable on the Uber app in Las Vegas, and this is the first time the Amazon-owned company has partnered with a ride-hailing platform.
unconfirmed: Fleet size, geographic coverage within Las Vegas, fares, service hours, whether vehicles run without human safety operators, and whether Zoox's own app continues to offer rides — none of these details appear in the available reporting, and neither company's claims were independently tested.

verified: TechCrunch 报道称，Zoox 的自动驾驶出租车已在拉斯维加斯上线于 Uber 应用内可供呼叫，Zoox 隶属亚马逊，且这是其与网约车平台的首次合作。
unconfirmed: 车队规模、可用时段与地理围栏范围、是否配备安全员、价格与补贴、Uber 与 Zoox 的分工和商业条款，以及车辆在真实运营中的表现，均仅见于单一媒体报道或未被提及；报道也未说明此前 Zoox 以何种方式载客。

titles.en: Zoox robotaxis join the Uber app in Las Vegas
titles.zh: Zoox 自动驾驶出租车接入 Uber 应用，落地拉斯维加斯
